name: template
description: The product template: an API and a web app that run on the platform, as one Compose project

scripts.local:up: zigordev-stack up && docker compose --file compose.yaml --file compose.local.yaml up --build --detach --wait
scripts.local:reset: docker compose --file compose.yaml --file compose.local.yaml down --volumes && pnpm run local:up
scripts.dev: sh -c 'test -n "$1" || { echo "Name the app: pnpm dev api, or pnpm dev web" >&2; exit 2; }; exec pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter "./apps/*-$1" run dev' --
scripts.check:contract: docker compose --file compose.yaml --file compose.local.yaml build && POSTGRES_PASSWORD=contract-only TEMPLATE_API_DATABASE_PASSWORD=contract-only KAFKA_PASSWORD=contract-only zigordev contract
